title: 2019 decision with Corrado Malanga to scan inside the Khufu pyramid
place_text: Great Pyramid of Khufu, Giza, Egypt

tellings.quote: according to my friend in 2019 Corrado Malanga we decided to do something concerning if if if it was possible to scan inside the um Khufu or Keops pyramid.
By in that case, it was the 2020 second generation Italian Cosmo-SkyMed satellite system.
tellings.difference: Says the scan was done in 2020 with data from the second-generation Italian Cosmo-SkyMed satellites.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of the Biondi–Malanga project to scan inside the Khufu pyramid; this telling names the satellite data the scan used.

as_told.title: The 2020 scan used Cosmo-SkyMed second-generation data

plain: In 2019, the scientist Filippo Biondi and his friend Corrado Malanga decided to try to scan the inside of the Great Pyramid of Khufu at Giza in Egypt. Biondi tells Michels this himself and, in a later episode, says the scan was done in 2020 using radar from the second-generation Italian Cosmo-SkyMed satellites, work written up in a paper on finding "undiscovered high-resolution internal structures" in the pyramid. If the method works as he says, it would show hidden structures inside and beneath the pyramid without digging.
